label: Figure 8.8: Shifting supply to remove excess demand for rice
alt: Rice market where supply shifts right from S1 to S2 so that it meets demand at the maximum price, at quantity Q3, eliminating the shortage.
caption: With a maximum price P<sub>max</sub> = $10 the shortage is 40 thousand tonnes (Q<sub>1</sub> = 40 supplied, 80 demanded). If the government subsidises growers, sells stored rice or provides rice directly, supply shifts right from S<sub>1</sub> to S<sub>2</sub>. S<sub>2</sub> cuts demand exactly at P<sub>max</sub>, so Q<sub>3</sub> = 80 is both demanded and supplied and the shortage disappears.
